messages:
Mira (CSM): quick heads-up: AcmeCorp (acct: acme-221) has 2 days before trial ends and only 1 API call in 10 days. renewal risk flagging up :exclamation:
OnboardingBot: Signal: low-activation + trial-expiry. Health score 66 -> 39 (rule: 72h low usage).
Mira (CSM): proposing a focused activation sprint: 45m pairing + targeted sample code + $300 starter credit + follow-up check-ins. keep it narrow: get embeddings pipeline running and first inference.
Rahul (AM): sounds good. if we do this, what's the clear downgrade/escape path if they still can't onboard? we should avoid surprise churn billing.
Mira (CSM): downgrade path draft: 1) Pause billed consumption for 30 days if onboarding incomplete, 2) offer limited "Core" tier with smaller quota and lower price, 3) retain access to docs + community. We offer this only once per trial.
Jon (CS Ops): approve $300 credit for activation sprint. file ticket with justification.
Lex (Support): I'll open a high-priority ticket for pairing and attach runbook. need preferred timezone and SRE contact (if they want deep debugging).
Sam (Enablement): I can host the 45m session. Availability Wed/Thu. I have a short lab and a 6-step checklist.
Mira (CSM): prefer Wed 11am PST. AcmeCorp ok? AcmeCorp: Wed 11am PST works. thanks Mira.
Mira (CSM): great. Sam, can you prepare: 1) 10m goals alignment 2) 20m live integration 3) 10m verify first pipeline + 5m next steps. Also share short async clip afterward.
Sam (Enablement): copying workshop checklist. will include a tiny curl snippet to test token/auths.
Sam (Enablement): snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"smol-emb-1","input":"hello"}'```
Lex (Support): ticket created: CS-SUPPORT-4082. pairing assigned to Eng-Pairing rota. adding on-call contact.
Mira (CSM): I'll send outreach with session invite + short prep guide and a 3-question feedback form (quick select + one freeform): choices = [auth, SDK, rate-limits, docs].
Dana (RevOps): flagging account tag: "activation_sprint_active" = true. start_ts=2945678901. I'll include cohort in weekly churn watch.
Rahul (AM): good. add a KPI: health >= 70 and first 3 API calls within 5 days. if not met, escalate to 1:1 renewal review with AM + pricing concession discussion.
Mira (CSM): noted. fallback if they decline live: we send a 12-min async lab + $150 credit.
Jon (CS Ops): please add refund rules to the credit ticket (non-refundable unless technical failure).
AcmeCorp: Quick Q 1: can pairing access include staging keys? we don't want prod tokens in session.
Mira (CSM): yes use staging keys. I'll DM the staging workspace link.
Sam (Enablement): I'll prep a short recording of the common auth error and solution.
Lex (Support): adding check: SDK v2.1 compatibility note to the runbook.
OnboardingBot: Post-session health scan scheduled: 2945679620 (72h).
Mira (CSM): action owners: Mira = invite + feedback form; Sam = run session + async clip; Lex = support ticket + pairing ops; Jon = credit ticket; Dana = cohort tagging; Rahul = escalation owner.
Mira (CSM): expected deliverables: session notes in the ticket, form responses pasted verbatim, and a follow-up email to customer with quick fixes.
Mira (CSM): I'll paste session notes and feedback here after the meeting. closing loop for now :white_check_mark:
